clusters.summary: [CJID] The National Cash Transfer Office (NCTO) said it paid ₦33.75 billion to 3.29 million citizens across 35 states in 2023. clusters.headline: Houthi attacks on strategic Saudi assets threaten Riyadh's regional leadership and economic ambitions
clusters.summary: As Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis continue to target Saudi Arabia, Riyadh's vulnerability threatens its claim on regional and religious leadership — as well as its standing as an economic powerhouse.

clusters.headline: Haze disrupts daily routines, hits businesses in Singapore's west as PSI reaches very unhealthy level
clusters.summary: Singapore's west has seen some of the highest haze readings in recent days, but experts say this may not continue as the situation remains dynamic.

clusters.headline: Nigeria: Tinubu Nominates Four New INEC National Commissioners, Two Resident Electoral Commissioners
clusters.summary: [Premium Times] President Tinubu urged the Senate to expedite the nominees' confirmation in view of the forthcoming general elections next January.

clusters.headline: Africa: No, Spain Did Not Introduce Visa-Free Travel for Eight African Countries in April 2026
clusters.summary: [Africa Check] No, Spain did not introduce visa-free travel for eight African countries in April 2026

clusters.headline: Burnt out cars and shattered glass on Paris streets after protests turn to riots and looting
clusters.summary: Around 1,800 people were arrested after nationwide protests saw outbreaks of violence and vandalism.

clusters.headline: France: Protesters clash with police in nationwide protests, amid rising social polarization
clusters.summary: Unrest broke out in parts of France as students, trade unionists and Yellow Vest activists took to the streets to protest high prices and inequality. Police arrested over 1,000 people amid chaotic scenes.

clusters.headline: Oregon school shooting: Police praise 'heroism' of those who intervened to stop more killing
clusters.summary: US police have praised the actions of three people who cut short a deadly shooting at a school in the state of Oregon. Three children and a teacher were killed in the attack, carried out by a former pupil at the school.

clusters.headline: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'
clusters.summary: The discovery of 12 women's bodies near Johannesburg has again highlighted South Africa's problem with violence against women.

clusters.headline: Mourners killed by Kenya police at Odinga national farewell not part of violence, BBC finds
clusters.summary: After analysing 1,500 videos and images of the Raila Odinga memorial, Africa Eye finds that those killed were far from the scuffles.

clusters.headline: Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat
clusters.summary: Satellite images give clues about how Kim spends his holidays - something far out of reach for most North Koreans.
